summary: Provides OAuth2 authorization for access to Earth Engine.
extended_definition: Provides OAuth2 authorization for access to Earth Engine.

supporting_pages.title: Authentication and Initialization | Google Earth Engine | Google for Developers
evidence_snippets: Browser: Confirmation Screen The browser will show a page confirming that you are authenticated, and the earthengine authenticate command in your terminal window will report "Successfully saved authorization token." In remote cases, the web page will give you a code to paste back into the Python environment.

If you are working in a web-only environment without access to a local terminal, and you still need to use a remote terminal, you can still initialize the command line tool by triggering the notebook mode by running the earthengine authenticate --auth_mode=notebook command.
This will require you to authenticate with gcloud from a machine that has access to a web browser.
